subject.title: fix: preserve discovered context limits over static metadata

question: Should every provider-discovery result captured in the shared prepared catalog override lower bundled/static context metadata, or should authority be explicitly scoped by source?
rationale: The Copilot documentation supports live-first behavior, but this patch moves that precedence into shared model-catalog infrastructure used by all discovery-capable providers.

options.title: Confirm shared live-first authority
options.body: Confirm that all captured discovery rows are authoritative for context windows, then refresh and merge this focused implementation.

options.title: Scope authority explicitly
options.body: Require a trusted-source marker or provider-specific authority boundary before static metadata can be prevented from lowering a discovered limit.

recommendation.title: Confirm shared live-first authority
recommendation.body: Confirm that all captured discovery rows are authoritative for context windows, then refresh and merge this focused implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged lifecycle refactor owns the prepared snapshot contract and is the narrowest decision point for provider-wide provenance semantics.
